messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: runtime-proxy.latency.spline_flutter - severity: P2. Routed to oncall rotation. Link: https://pd.example/INC12345 :rotating_light:
Maya R.: acked. I'm on it, pulling graphs.
Rohit K.: on call pager here, what are we seeing?
Maya R.: 35s p95 spikes for a ~6m window, started ~10m ago, then intermittent. No 5xx spike in logs. Looks like KV-prefill + routing reshuffle.
Sam B.: adding metrics: https://grafana.example/d/abc/runtime-proxy?from=now-30m&to=now - canaries ticked but customer error rate stayed flat.
Rohit K.: OK. If error rate is flat it's likely warmup/warmth jitter. Can we suppress PD noisy escalation while we watch?
Maya R.: suggest silencing PD for 20m to avoid dup pages while we autocheck. I'll run the silence.
Maya R.: `/pd incidents silence --service runtime-proxy --duration 20m --reason "ephemeral latency spike; monitoring"`
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Silence applied by Maya R. (20m) :white_check_mark:
Rohit K.: thanks. I'll tail router logs for anomalies, and check routing table churn.
Sam B.: logs show a few backend attach/detach events against worker-pool-7 around the first spike. Might be autoscaler thrash.
Rohit K.: good catch. Attaching a quick grep:
```
kubectl get events -n inference | grep worker-pool-7
# ~ 03:08  kubelet: Started container
# ~ 03:09  autoscaler: scaled down 1
# ~ 03:11  autoscaler: scaled up 1
```
Maya R.: autoscaler down/up could cause KV cache miss storms leading to p95 blips. No customer 5xx so low impact.
Rohit K.: I'll pin a temporary routing policy to prefer warm pools for 10m to reduce cold-attach tail. Command: `rwctl route set-policy runtime-proxy --prefer warm-pool --ttl 10m`
Sam B.: done. Confirmed on control-plane.
Maya R.: nice. We should monitor for another cycle.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Alert INC12345 acknowledged by Maya R.
Rohit K.: watching graphs. p95 coming down from 35s -> 12s over 4 mins.
Maya R.: incident-bot shows auto-resolve event?
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC12345 status changed to resolved (auto-resolve). Reason: metric returned below threshold.
Sam B.: reflex: no obvious customer impact observed, synthetic canaries recovered, routing policy applied.
Maya R.: quick postmortem notes for the log: transient autoscaler churn caused KV cache warm misses; mitigation: temporary prefer-warm routing and silence to avoid noisy PD churn.
Rohit K.: agree. I'll create a short ticket for longer-term mitigation (ensure autoscaler stabilization window, or stagger restarts).
Maya R.: handing off to Linda for overnight watch. Linda C.: thanks, I see the notes. I'll keep an eye and escalate if it reappears.
Linda C.: pinging oncall-runbook channel and adding `#followup` tag to INC12345 in Tracker.
Maya R.: TL;DR for handoff: ephemeral p95 latency spikes due to autoscaler attach/detach; no customer 5xx; applied prefer-warm routing; PD silence applied; incident auto-resolved; follow-up ticket created. :thumbsup:
Linda C.: got it. I'll keep watch for 2 hours then close follow-ups. :eyes:
Maya R.: thanks everyone. Closing thread here.
